name: agentwallet-mcp

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a new EVM or Solana wallet. Returns the wallet ID and address. Private key is encrypted server-side and never exposed.

tools.name: list_wallets
tools.description: List all wallets owned by the authenticated user. Returns wallet IDs, addresses, labels, chain IDs, and status.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Get details for a specific wallet by ID. Returns address, label, chain, spending limits, and pause status.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the native token balance for a wallet on a specific chain. Returns balance in both wei (or lamports for Solana) and human-readable format.

chain_id.description: Chain ID to check (defaults to wallet's default chain)

tools.name: sign_transaction
tools.description: Sign a transaction with a wallet's private key. For EVM: returns signed raw transaction hex. For Solana: returns base64 signed transaction. Does NOT broadcast. Use send_transaction for sign + broadcast. A signed transaction is a spend: under a spend policy it is checked, reserved on the ledger and counted against the budgets exactly as send_transaction is, because the caller can broadcast it.

to.description: Destination address (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana)

value.description: Value in wei/lamports (decimal integer string; no hex, no decimals)

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata (0x-prefixed) for EVM contract calls

gas_limit.description: Gas limit — EVM only (auto-estimated if omitted)

max_fee.description: Max fee per gas in wei — EVM only (auto if omitted)

priority_fee.description: Max priority fee per gas in wei — EVM only (auto if omitted)

token_mint.description: SPL token mint address — Solana only (for SPL token transfers)

token_decimals.description: SPL token decimals, Solana only (6 for USDC)

tools.name: send_transaction
tools.description: Sign and broadcast a transaction. Returns the transaction hash (EVM) or signature (Solana) on success. The transaction is signed server-side and broadcast via RPC.

to.description: Destination address (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana)

value.description: Value in wei/lamports (decimal integer string; no hex, no decimals)

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata (0x-prefixed) for EVM contract calls

gas_limit.description: Gas limit — EVM only (auto-estimated if omitted)

max_fee.description: Max fee per gas in wei — EVM only (auto if omitted)

priority_fee.description: Max priority fee per gas in wei — EVM only (auto if omitted)

token_mint.description: SPL token mint address — Solana only (for SPL token transfers)

token_decimals.description: SPL token decimals, Solana only (6 for USDC)

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Send native tokens (ETH, AVAX, BNB, POL, PLS, SOL) to an address. Specify the amount in human-readable format (e.g. "0.1" for 0.1 ETH). The amount is converted to wei/lamports automatically. Signs and broadcasts the transaction.

to.description: Destination address (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana)

amount.description: Amount to send in human-readable format (e.g. "0.1" for 0.1 ETH)

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Get the ERC-20 or SPL token balance for a wallet on a specific chain. Returns the raw balance and human-readable balance. Use get_chains to find stablecoin addresses for each chain.

token.description: Token address (0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract for EVM, Base58 mint for Solana)

decimals.description: Token decimals. Taken from the response or the token contract when omitted

tools.name: transfer_token
tools.description: Send ERC-20 tokens (EVM) or SPL tokens (Solana) to an address. Specify the amount in human-readable format (e.g. "100" for 100 USDC). Signs and broadcasts the transaction. Use get_chains to find stablecoin addresses.

token.description: Token address (0x-prefixed ERC-20 contract for EVM, Base58 mint for Solana)

to.description: Recipient address (0x-prefixed for EVM, Base58 for Solana)

amount.description: Amount in human-readable format (e.g. "100" for 100 USDC)

decimals.description: Token decimals. Resolved from the registry or the token contract when omitted; if given, it must match

tools.name: call_contract
tools.description: Execute a read-only call against a smart contract (eth_call). Returns the raw hex result. Does not cost gas or modify state. Useful for reading on-chain data like token balances, prices, positions.

tools.name: approve_token
tools.description: Approve a spender contract to transfer ERC-20 tokens on your behalf. Required before interacting with any DeFi protocol (DEXs, lending, etc.). Use amount "max" for unlimited approval, or specify an exact amount. Under a spend policy an approval is a spend: it counts against the budgets, the spender is checked as a recipient, and "max" is refused.

spender.description: Contract address to approve as spender

amount.description: Amount to approve in human-readable format (e.g. "1000"), or "max" for unlimited

decimals.description: Token decimals. Resolved from the registry or the token contract when omitted; if given, it must match

tools.name: get_allowance
tools.description: Check how many ERC-20 tokens a spender is approved to transfer. Returns the allowance in both raw and human-readable format. Use this to check if an approval is needed before a DeFi transaction.

wallet_id.description: Wallet ID (used to determine the owner address)

decimals.description: Token decimals. Resolved from the registry or the token contract when omitted; if given, it must match

tools.name: wrap_eth
tools.description: Wrap native tokens (ETH, AVAX, BNB, POL, PLS) into their wrapped ERC-20 version (WETH, WAVAX, etc.). Required for most DeFi protocols that use ERC-20 tokens instead of raw native tokens. Specify amount in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5" for 0.5 ETH).

amount.description: Amount to wrap in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5")

tools.name: unwrap_eth
tools.description: Unwrap wrapped tokens (WETH, WAVAX, WBNB, etc.) back to native tokens. Specify amount in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5" for 0.5 WETH).

amount.description: Amount to unwrap in human-readable format (e.g. "0.5")

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Get the name, symbol, and decimals of any ERC-20 token by its contract address. Useful for discovering token details before transfers or approvals.

tools.name: pay_x402
tools.description: Handle an x402 payment flow. Fetches a URL, and if the server returns HTTP 402 Payment Required, parses the payment requirements (v1 body or v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header), signs an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for the "exact" scheme (no gas, nothing broadcast by the payer), and retries the request with the payment header. AgentWallet paywalls are paid by on-chain transfer instead. The "upto" scheme is settled with a Permit2 authorization bounded by the cap. Returns the final response and the settlement receipt. Supports the x402 open payment standard (https://x402.org). max_payment can only lower the operator's cap for one call.

url.description: The URL to access (will handle 402 payment if required)

headers.description: Optional JSON string of additional request headers. Credentials placed here (Authorization, Cookie, API keys) are sent only to the origin in `url`; if the endpoint redirects to a different origin they are dropped, not forwarded.

body.description: Optional request body for POST/PUT requests

max_payment.description: Maximum payment in human-readable format (e.g. "1.00" for 1 USDC). Lowers the operator's AGENTWALLET_MAX_AUTOPAY ceiling (default "1") for this one call; it can never raise it, and a value above the ceiling is ignored and reported as max_payment_ignored.

prefer_chain.description: Preferred chain ID if the server accepts payment on multiple chains (e.g. 8453 for Base, 1 for Ethereum)

request_approval.description: Hosted wallets only. When the payment exceeds the cap, email the wallet owner an approve/deny link instead of refusing, and return an approval_id to retry with. Default true unless AGENTWALLET_APPROVALS=0.

approval_id.description: An approval id from an earlier over-cap attempt. Once the owner has approved it, pass it here to make that one payment.

fresh_authorization.description: Sign a new authorization even if one for the same endpoint, amount and recipient is still valid. By default a repeat call within the validity window re-sends the earlier signature (same nonce, so it cannot settle twice) instead of paying again.

tools.name: check_approval
tools.description: Status of a payment approval created when pay_x402 exceeded the cap on a hosted wallet. Returns pending, approved, denied or expired. Once approved, call pay_x402 again with approval_id.

tools.name: approve_permit2
tools.description: One-time ERC-20 approval of a token to the Permit2 contract, needed before paying x402 "upto" endpoints with that token. A normal on-chain transaction (needs gas). By default approves the maximum, the ecosystem norm, so it never has to be repeated; pass amount to grant a bounded allowance instead (required under AGENTWALLET_MAX_TX_TOKEN and under a spend policy, both of which refuse a max approval; under a policy the allowance counts against the budgets). Permit2 itself only moves what each signed authorization allows.

token.description: ERC-20 token address (e.g. USDC on Base)

amount.description: Allowance to grant in human units (e.g. "100"). Omit for unlimited.

tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Assess an ERC-20 token before approving or swapping it: honeypot, taxes, owner powers, verified source, holder concentration, DEX liquidity. Uses GoPlus Security (free, no key) with an on-chain fallback. A warning for the caller to weigh, never a block.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Get the current month's usage statistics. Returns operations count, tier info, remaining quota, and fees.

tools.name: buy_verification_credits
tools.description: Buy x402 verification credits with USDC on-chain. Paywall owners need credits to process verifications beyond the free tier (1,000/month) when they don't have Stripe billing configured. Returns 402 payment instructions — pay on-chain and retry with proof.

count.description: Number of verification credits to purchase (min 100, default 1000)

tools.name: pause_wallet
tools.description: Emergency pause a wallet. No transactions can be signed while paused.

tools.name: unpause_wallet
tools.description: Resume a paused wallet so transactions can be signed again.

tools.name: get_chains
tools.description: List all supported chains (EVM + Solana) with their chain IDs, native tokens, stablecoins, and RPC configuration status.

tools.name: delete_wallet
tools.description: Delete (soft-delete) a wallet. The wallet will no longer appear in listings and cannot be used for transactions. The wallet is read first and the delete names its address, so a wallet that cannot be read is never deleted.

tools.name: create_paywall
tools.description: Create an x402 paywall that charges agents/clients for accessing a resource. Returns a public access URL that returns HTTP 402 until paid. Agents pay on-chain, then retry with proof to get the content.

amount.description: Price in human-readable format (e.g. "0.01" for 0.01 USDC)

token_type.description: "erc20" for EVM stablecoins, "spl" for Solana SPL tokens, "native" for ETH/SOL/POL/etc.

token_address.description: Token contract address (ERC-20 for EVM, SPL mint Base58 for Solana). Required if token_type is "erc20" or "spl". Use get_chains to find stablecoin addresses.

token_decimals.description: Token decimals. Defaults to the chain native decimals for "native", else 6 (USDC); set it for any other token

resource_url.description: URL of the protected resource to serve after payment verification

tools.name: list_paywalls
tools.description: List all your x402 paywalls. Returns paywall IDs, names, pricing, access URLs, payment counts, and revenue totals.

tools.name: get_paywall
tools.description: Get details for a specific x402 paywall by ID. Returns pricing, access URL, payment stats, and configuration.

tools.name: update_paywall
tools.description: Update an x402 paywall configuration. Can change price, resource URL, active status, or any other field.

token_decimals.description: Token decimals. Read from the paywall itself when omitted

tools.name: delete_paywall
tools.description: Delete an x402 paywall. The access URL will return 404 after deletion.

tools.name: get_paywall_payments
tools.description: Get payment history for a specific x402 paywall. Returns verified payments with TX hashes, payer addresses, amounts, and timestamps.

tools.name: get_x402_revenue
tools.description: Get aggregate x402 revenue statistics across all your paywalls. Returns total payments and revenue broken down by chain and token.

tools.name: quote_x402
tools.description: Ask what an x402 endpoint charges without paying: fetches the URL, parses the 402 requirements, says which option this wallet would pay (chain, asset, amount, recipient), whether the per-payment cap, the spend policy and the rolling budgets would allow it, and nothing is signed. Call it before pay_x402 when the price is unknown.

method.description: HTTP method the real request would use

headers.description: Optional JSON string of request headers, as for pay_x402

body.description: Optional request body, as for pay_x402

prefer_chain.description: Preferred chain ID when several are offered

tools.name: discover_x402
tools.description: Find x402-paid APIs by subject in the public x402 index (the Bazaar published by the CDP facilitator). Returns resources with their method, price and chain, re-priced from this client's own registry. Listings are sellers' own words. Nothing is paid; follow up with quote_x402 or pay_x402.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the resource URL, service name, description or tags (case-insensitive)

offset.description: Index offset to continue from (use next_offset from the previous call)

chain_id.description: Only resources payable on this chain

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: Spends recorded in this wallet's ledger (x402 payments, transfers, auto-pay), newest first, each with its latest outcome (signed, settled, declined, unknown, broadcast, void). The ledger is a hash-chained append-only file when AGENTWALLET_LEDGER or a policy names one; otherwise this process only.

host.description: Only payments to this endpoint host

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only spends at or after it

tools.name: export_receipts
tools.description: Every spend in the ledger as CSV or JSONL text (oldest first), for expense records. Returns the text; write it wherever it belongs.

tools.name: spend_policy
tools.description: The spend policy this server enforces (AGENTWALLET_POLICY), its sha256, the rolling budgets with what is spent and what remains, per-host spending, the ledger's path and integrity, and whether the connected client can answer approval questions. Read-only.

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description: Dry-run an EVM transaction with nothing signed: the local guards (native cap, token cap, fee cap), the spend policy, the node's gas estimate (which fails when the call would revert), the worst-case fee, whether the balance covers it, and the call's return data. Local mode runs the full check; hosted mode runs the policy and an eth_call.

value.description: Native amount in human units (e.g. "0.01" ETH)

tools.name: wallet_mode
tools.description: Report whether this server is signing locally (self-custody, the private key never leaves this machine) or through the hosted AgentWallet API (custodial). Use this to verify custody before moving funds.

tools.name: export_wallet_key
tools.description: Explain how to export the private key of a hosted (custodial) AgentWallet so it can be moved to self-custody or any other wallet. Export itself is deliberately human-gated and is not performed by this tool.

instructions:
AgentWallet gives AI agents their own blockchain wallets. Private keys are encrypted server-side and never exposed: agents sign and broadcast transactions without ever touching raw keys.

## Getting Started
1. Call list_wallets to see existing wallets, or create_wallet to make a new one.
2. Fund the wallet by sending tokens to its address from an external source.
3. Use transfer (native tokens) or transfer_token (ERC-20/SPL tokens) to send funds.

## Supported Chains
- **EVM chains:** Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Optimism (10), Polygon (137), Avalanche (43114), BSC (56), Zora (7777777), PulseChain (369)
- **Solana:** Mainnet (900), Devnet (901), Testnet (902)
- Call get_chains for the full list with native tokens and stablecoin contract addresses.

## EVM vs Solana
- **Addresses:** EVM uses 0x-prefixed hex (42 chars). Solana uses Base58 (32-44 chars).
- **Native tokens:** EVM = ETH/POL/BNB/etc (18 decimals, wei). Solana = SOL (9 decimals, lamports).
- **Token standards:** EVM uses ERC-20. Solana uses SPL tokens.
- **EVM-only tools:** approve_token, get_allowance, wrap_eth, unwrap_eth, call_contract, get_token_info. These do not work on Solana.
- **Works on both:** create_wallet, transfer, transfer_token, send_transaction, sign_transaction, get_balance, get_token_balance.

## Common Workflows

### Send native tokens (ETH, SOL, etc.)
Use the transfer tool with a human-readable amount (e.g. "0.1" ETH). It auto-converts to wei/lamports.

### Send ERC-20 or SPL tokens
Use transfer_token. You need: wallet_id, token contract address, recipient, amount, chain_id, and decimals (6 for USDC, 18 for most ERC-20s). Call get_chains to find stablecoin addresses.

### Interact with DeFi (EVM only)
1. Check allowance with get_allowance.
2. If needed, call approve_token to let the DeFi contract spend your tokens.
3. Use send_transaction with the contract's calldata to execute the interaction.

### Wrap/unwrap native tokens (EVM only)
Use wrap_eth to convert ETH → WETH (required by many DeFi protocols). Use unwrap_eth to convert back.

### Read on-chain data (EVM only)
Use call_contract for gas-free read-only calls (eth_call). Provide ABI-encoded calldata.

## x402 Payments — Paying for Resources
The pay_x402 tool handles the full x402 payment flow automatically:
1. Fetches the URL.
2. If the server returns HTTP 402, parses the payment requirements.
3. Pays on-chain using your wallet.
4. Retries the request with proof of payment.
Always set max_payment to prevent overspending (e.g. "1.00" for max 1 USDC).

## x402 Paywalls — Accepting Payments
Create paywalls to charge other agents for accessing your resources:
1. create_paywall — set price, token, chain, and the resource URL to protect.
2. Share the access URL. Clients that pay on-chain get the resource; others get HTTP 402.
3. list_paywalls and get_paywall_payments to track revenue.
4. get_x402_revenue for aggregate stats across all paywalls.

## Wallet Security
- Use pause_wallet to immediately freeze a wallet if compromised. No transactions can be signed while paused.
- Use unpause_wallet to resume operations.
- Use delete_wallet to permanently disable a wallet.
- Wallets have server-enforced spending limits.

## Tool Selection Guide
| Goal | Tool |
|------|------|
| Send ETH/SOL/native tokens | transfer |
| Send USDC/ERC-20/SPL tokens | transfer_token |
| Check native balance | get_balance |
| Check token balance | get_token_balance |
| Look up token details | get_token_info (EVM only) |
| Approve DeFi spending | approve_token (EVM only) |
| Check approval amount | get_allowance (EVM only) |
| Read smart contract | call_contract (EVM only) |
| Custom transaction | send_transaction |
| Sign without broadcasting | sign_transaction |
| Pay for x402 resource | pay_x402 |
| Charge for your resource | create_paywall |
| Check usage/billing | get_usage |
